title_sq: DYQAN PER SHITJE TEK RRUGA MYSLYM SHYRI!
description_sq:
Dyqan per shitje tek Rruga Myslym Shyri.
Dyqani ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara per biznes ne qytetin e Tiranes.
Ndodhet buze rruge ne katin zero.
Dyqani posedon nje depo 20m2 ne katin -1 i shfrytezueshem nga dyqani, si dhe hapesire perpara dyqanit 6 m2.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion me kontaktoni!

title_en: SHOP FOR SALE ON MYSLYM STREET, SHYRI!
description_en: Shop for sale at Myslym Shyri Street. The store is located in one of the most preferred areas for business in the city of Tirana. It is located on the side of the road on the ground floor. The store has a 20 m2 warehouse on the -1st floor that can be used by the store, as well as a 6 m2 space in front of the store. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information contact me! Diana
